prompt:
Look at the shape-assembly puzzle in the image: an outline-style shape-assembly puzzle with several colored pieces above labeled silhouette options. Which option can be formed by using all the pieces exactly once if pieces may be rotated but not flipped? Select the correct option and answer with the option letter.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the correct option panel.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact option letter of the correct image option.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[222,488,398,692]],"answer":"C"}
